prose: The great Herbalism teacher Sajah Popham joins InnerVerse to discuss his book, Evolutionary Herbalism. In this conversation we explore Sajah's calling to plant medicine, the fractal wholeness of nature in each being, the alchemist's secret fire, gnosis of the heart, training intuition, plants as conscious beings, holistic evaluation for treating people instead of symptoms, and the healing achieved by reframing our identity-story.
ext: You'll learn about the plant patterns taught by alchemy & astrology, how to connect the metaphysical to the material, the threefold pattern of nature, Mercury the savior & spiritual alchemy, the creation of the pure plant stone and its mysterious power, planetary signatures of plants, and tips on how to develop a personal relationship with the planets.
